summary: Regression test after retiring OT stubs, Category Health, and Escort Photo Cleanup. 8/9 backend tests pass; the 1 failure is a cold-start read timeout on a standalone login test (login succeeds in all subsequent fixture-based tests). All 4 retired endpoints correctly return 404. All sibling endpoints in edited files still work (attendance/status, calendar-grid, usage/report, escort-attendance list). Frontend admin side-nav no longer shows the retired links; direct navigation to retired routes does not crash the app (renders shell without error boundary). The Grid at /admin/reports renders fully.

minor.issue: Occasional cold-start read timeout >30s on first standalone call; subsequent calls fine. Likely infra cold start, not code regression.
